subject: eng
title: Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: If I ___ a writer, I ___ write books about animals.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.19 & p.28：第二類條件句（假設現在不可能或相反的情況），if 子句用過去式 were，主句用 would + 原形動詞。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: If I ___ a writer, I ___ write books about animals.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: If Candy ___ a dragon, she ___ ride on it.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.28 Section C Q1：遇見龍是幻想情境（Second conditional），用 If Candy met a dragon, she would ride on it。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: If Candy ___ a dragon, she ___ ride on it.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: Susan is the girl ___ is performing a magic show.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.20 & p.27：先行詞 the girl 是人，關係代詞（relative pronoun）用 who。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Susan is the girl ___ is performing a magic show.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: This is a wallet ___ is made of soft leather.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.20 & p.27：先行詞 a wallet 是物件，關係代詞用 which。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: This is a wallet ___ is made of soft leather.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: The clown's jokes were very ___. All the audience felt ___.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.21 & p.28：形容事物「令人發笑的」用 -ing 形容詞 amusing；形容人「感到好笑的」用 -ed 形容詞 amused。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The clown's jokes were very ___. All the audience felt ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: The prince showed true love to the princess. Everyone was deeply ___.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.28 Section D Q2：形容人「深受感動」要用 -ed 形容詞 touched（而非 touching）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The prince showed true love to the princess. Everyone was deeply ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 5: Second Conditional, Relative Pronouns & -ed/-ing Adjectives

questions.q: Correct the mistake (Grammar 6A p.28 Section D Q4): 'If I am Rapunzel, I would let down my long hair.' -> Change 'am' to:
questions.explain: 第二類條件句中，If I 後面用虛擬語氣 were（If I were Rapunzel...）。

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a second conditional sentence (Grammar 6A p.28).
items: she would draw a picture of it
questions.explain: 第二類條件句：If Amy saw a fairy, she would draw a picture of it.
answer: she would draw a picture of it
